milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Boss fight in Fungal Wastes; requires dodging ring attacks and landing Nail hits or using Shade Cloak + Spell build

milestones.name: Acquire Love Key
milestones.note: Found on a corpse in the southeast of the Queen's Gardens above the path to the Fungal Wastes; requires Isma's Tear to retrieve

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.fingerprintHint: Area containing Elder Hu boss fight; connects to Queen's Gardens

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.fingerprintHint: Southeast area where Love Key is found on a corpse above path to Fungal Wastes

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where Love Key can be used

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.grants: Invincible dash; used to dodge Elder Hu's Ring Slam attack
abilities.note: Highly recommended for Elder Hu fight; not completely necessary

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.grants: Spell attack usable against Elder Hu
abilities.note: Can be used with Spell build to quickly defeat Elder Hu

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.grants: Upgraded spell attack usable against Elder Hu
abilities.note: Upgrade of Howling Wraiths; part of recommended Spell build

abilities.name: Isma's Tear
abilities.grants: Required to reach Love Key corpse in Queen's Gardens
abilities.note: Needed to retrieve the Love Key

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.note: Found on a corpse in the southeast of Queen's Gardens above the path to Fungal Wastes

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Uses ring attacks and a Ring Slam attack; remains stationary and floats low to the ground; rhythm-based dodge and attack pattern

objectives.name: Defeat Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Dodge Elder Hu's ring attacks by timing dashes (Shade Cloak recommended) and strike with Nail in between, or use Shade Cloak + Howling Wraiths/Abyss Shriek with a Spell build (Shaman Stone, Spell Twister, Soul Catcher, Soul Eater)

objectives.name: Retrieve the Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the southeast of Queen's Gardens above the path to Fungal Wastes; use Isma's Tear to access the corpse holding the Love Key

objectives.name: Use the Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: Bring the Love Key to the City of Tears to unlock its associated door/gate

connectors.description: Path from Queen's Gardens leads down to Fungal Wastes; Love Key corpse is located above this path in Queen's Gardens
Love Key acquired near Fungal Wastes path is used in the City of Tears
